orders.text:
AO No. 635 of 2016
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J. 
Mr. V.K. Kohli, Senior Advocate 
assisted by Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate 
for the appellant. 
Learned counsel for the appellant 
has raised many points against this 
inordinate exorbitant award passed 
by the learned Tribunal. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to all the 
respondents calling their response, if 
any. 
Recovery against the appellant 
shall remain stayed subject to deposit 
of Rupees twenty five lakhs of the 
total awarded amount, adjusting 
compulsory statutory amount, within 
six weeks from today before the 
Tribunal concerned. 
Connect this appeal with AO 
No. 627 of 2016. 
Stay Application (CLMA No. 
12252/2016) stands disposed of. 
Let a certified copy of this 
order be supplied to the learned 
counsel for the appellant, today itself, 
on payment of usual charges. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
29.11.2016 
Pooja/A.Kaur

AO No.26 of 2017 
With 
AO No.627 of 2016 
AO No.635 of 2016 
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. 
Mr. D.S. Patni, Senior Advocate assisted by 
Mr. Syed Nadim, Advocate for the 
claimants/appellants in AO No. 26 of 2017. 
 Mr. Prabhat Pande, Advocate for the 
National Insurance Company Limited. 
 Mr. V.K. Kohli, Senior Advocate assisted 
by Ms. Rajni Supyal, Advocate for the Oriental 
Insurance Company Limited. 
 Let the two Insurance Companies i.e. 
National Insurance Company Limited and Oriental 
Insurance Company Limited deposit an amount of 
Rs.25,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Lakh only) 
each before the concerned Tribunal before the next 
date of listing, which is fixed for 19.12.2019, 
failing which the entire amount be recovered as 
arrears of land revenue from the insurance 
companies. 
 List these cases on 19.12.2019 in the daily 
cause list. 
 Meanwhile, the claimants would be at 
liberty to move an appropriate application before 
the concerned Tribunal for withdrawal of an 
amount of Rs.50,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Lakh 
only), which has already been deposited by the 
two insurance companies. 
 In case, such an application is moved by the 
claimants, the same shall be decided without 
asking for any surety. 
 
 
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 
 10.12.2019
Ankit/

AO No.635 of 2016 
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. 
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
 Mr. D.S. Patni, Senior Advocate assisted 
by Mr. Siddhant Manral, Advocate for the 
claimants/respondent nos. 1 to 3. 
 In compliance of this Court’s order 
dated 10.12.2019, the appellant has deposited a 
further amount of Rs.25,00,000/- (Rupees 
Twenty Five Lakh only) before the concerned 
Tribunal. 
 Now a money withdrawal application 
being CLMA No. 381 of 2020 has been filed 
by the claimants/respondent nos. 1 to 3. 
 Money withdrawal application is 
allowed. 
 Let the amount of Rs.20,00,000/- 
(Rupees Twenty Lakh only) be released in 
favour of the claimants/respondent nos. 1 to 3 
forthwith on their moving an appropriate 
application before the concerned Tribunal. The 
amount shall be given to each of the claimant 
in proportion to what has been fixed by the 
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal. 
 List this case after three weeks in the 
daily cause list. 
 
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 10.01.2020 
Ankit/
